name: Paparan produk premium
direction: Create a restrained premium hero presentation: begin with a clear view of the exact product, make one gentle camera move, highlight only one visible detail, then hold a clean full-product hero frame. Use soft controlled light and realistic contact shadows; no dramatic spin or fabricated view.

name: Paparan katalog minimal
direction: Use a clean uncluttered composition with generous negative space and stable framing. Keep the full product readable, use subtle light and a small push-in only if it preserves geometry, then finish on a still hero view. Do not add props, captions or graphic marks unless the chosen style explicitly requests them.

name: Susunan dan paparan kemas
direction: Arrange the product in a tidy, balanced composition using only items already visible or explicitly confirmed as included. Use a gentle overhead or near-overhead camera drift, preserve the original silhouette and packaging, and end with a clear view of the complete product.

name: Unboxing berhati-hati
direction: If the reference clearly shows packaging that can be opened, reveal only what is visible or confirmed; otherwise present the packaged product without inventing contents. Use slow, practical hand movement, consistent packaging details and a clean final product view. No surprise accessories or unsupported claims.

name: Hook visual dan reveal
direction: Open with an interesting but truthful framing or light reveal, not a false result or exaggerated effect. Reveal the complete product early, show one visible detail, then settle into a polished hero shot. Keep transitions restrained and never morph, duplicate or make the product fly.
